# Retirement: Pod name dimension in AKS pod platform metrics

## What Changed

Beginning September 30, 2027, support for the pod name dimension on the following Azure Monitor platform metrics is retiring, and these metrics are transitioning to aggregate pod counters:Number of pods by phase (kube_pod_status_phase)Number of pods in Re
